Prompt to build this component

When to use it

When to use

  • Beside a number, to show the series it ends: a count per week, a rate per release, passes per run.
  • Inside a sentence or a table cell, at the size of a word, where a chart would interrupt the reading.
  • Many at once, one per row, to compare trends down a table.

When not to use

  • To compare values against each other at one moment: use cmp-chart (bar or dot).
  • When the reader needs each value: write them, or use cmp-chart with a table.
  • For fewer than three points: write the numbers.
Variants, anatomy, accessibility, interaction and content rules

Variants

  • line — a thin line through the series, its last point marked. The base class alone; no modifier class.
  • bars — one thin bar per point on a shared baseline, the last one in the accent; for counts per period.

Anatomy

  • Root: <span class="ds-sparkline" data-spark role="img" aria-label="…"> (add ds-sparkline--bars). It sits in the line of text, a word wide and a cap high.
  • Plot: <svg class="ds-sparkline__plot" viewBox="0 0 100 20" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">. Positions that are data are coordinates on 0 to 100 across and 0 to 20 down (the highest value at the top).
  • line: <polyline class="ds-sparkline__line" points="0,16 25,10 …">, then the marks.
  • bars: one <rect class="ds-sparkline__bar" x="…" y="…" width="…" height="…"> per point; the last adds ds-sparkline__bar--last.
  • Marks: <line class="ds-sparkline__mark" x1 x2 y1 y2> with the same point twice (a dot): the last point; with-range, also ds-sparkline__mark--low and ds-sparkline__mark--high.
  • Value: <span class="ds-sparkline__value">, the last value, written as the source gives it.
  • Range (with-range): <span class="ds-sparkline__range" data-toggle="with-range">, the lowest and highest values.

Accessibility

  • The root is an image named by its aria-label: what the series is, every value in order, then the last, lowest and highest ("Changes per week: 1, 3, 0, 5. Last 5, lowest 0, highest 5"). The plot is hidden; the written value repeats the last one for sighted readers.
  • The line and marks meet 3:1 against the surface beneath in every theme; the value uses text-default.
  • Not focusable and has no controls.

Interaction

  • Not interactive: nothing highlights on hover (int-04).
  • instant: default — a sparkline is redrawn whole when its series changes; nothing moves.

Content rules

  • One series per sparkline, one unit. Name it in the sentence, the row or the label beside it.
  • At least three points, at most about thirty; older points to the left.
  • The value is the last point, with its unit: "5", "84%".

Do and don't

  • Do set it beside its number, in the line of text.
  • Do keep one scale down a column of sparklines that compare.
  • Don't add axes, gridlines or a title: the words around it are its labels.
  • Don't use colour for anything but the last point.
